questions.question_text: What is mentorship primarily defined as?

correct_answer.text: A relationship in which a more experienced person guides a less experienced individual.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is NOT a benefit of having a mentor?
What is one key difference between formal and informal mentors?

correct_answer.text: Formal mentors are part of structured programs, while informal mentors arise from personal connections.

questions.question_text: When approaching a potential mentor, what is an important step to take?

correct_answer.text: Send a brief message introducing yourself and explaining why you are reaching out.
